import inspect
import unittest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import torch
from vllm_ascend.spec_decode.dspark_proposer import AscendDSparkProposer
from vllm_ascend.spec_decode.llm_base_proposer import AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer


class _DSparkProposerTestBase(unittest.TestCase):
    """基类：bypass __init__ 构造器，手工注入 9 项必需 buffer 字段"""

    def _make_proposer(self, max_num_tokens=256, dp_padding=0):
        proposer = AscendDSparkProposer.__new__(AscendDSparkProposer)
        proposer.max_num_tokens = max_num_tokens
        proposer.positions = torch.arange(max_num_tokens)
        proposer.input_ids = torch.zeros(max_num_tokens, dtype=torch.long)
        proposer.slot_mapping = torch.full((max_num_tokens,), -1, dtype=torch.long)
        # ... per_group_block_tables / per_group_slot_mappings 等 9 项缓冲区
        # 可设 stale 值 = -999 用于验证零化
        return proposer


class TestDSparkPositionsFullUnderMultiDp(_DSparkProposerTestBase):
    """覆盖 positions 不预切 + DP padding 零化（3 用例）"""

    def test_positions_not_pre_sliced(self):
        """断言 cad.positions.shape[0] == max_num_tokens 而非 num_query_total
        防 DP-padded num_input 超界 OOB —— 直接对应 a752217 L291 不再预切的修复"""
        for dp_padding in [0, 8, 32]:
            proposer = self._make_proposer(dp_padding=dp_padding)
            cad = MagicMock()
            proposer.set_inputs_first_pass(cad)
            self.assertEqual(cad.positions.shape[0], proposer.max_num_tokens)

    def test_positions_full_and_padded_for_dsa(self):
        """先设 -999 脏值 → _pad_draft_buffers → 断言 DP-pad 区全 0 = 验证零化"""
        for dp_padding in [8, 32]:
            proposer = self._make_proposer(dp_padding=dp_padding)
            proposer.positions[-dp_padding:] = -999
            proposer._pad_draft_buffers(...)
            self.assertTrue((proposer.positions[-dp_padding:] == 0).all())


class TestPadDraftBuffersBeforeBuild(_DSparkProposerTestBase):
    """覆盖 pad 顺序先 pad 后 build（4 用例）"""

    def test_zeros_dp_padding_region(self):
        """5 项缓冲区 DP-pad 区置 -999 → _pad 后必须全 0 / parallel_drafting_token_id / -1
        直接对应 a752217 llm_base_proposer.py L927 先 pad 后 build 的顺序调整"""
        ...

    def test_noop_without_dp_padding(self):
        """无 DP-pad 时 pad 操作 noop = snapshot 不变，防过度零化"""
        ...

    def test_must_precede_build(self):
        """正反例对照：先 pad→build = padding 区传 0；先 build→pad = padding 区传 -999
        = 复现旧序漏洞 = UT 失败"""
        ...

    def test_called_before_build_in_propose(self):
        """inspect.getsource(AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer._propose) 做静态断言：
        _pad_draft_buffers 调用字符串索引 < build_draft_attn_metadata 调用字符串索引
        = 源码级顺序保证 guard（refactor 会自动 inert 不报错）"""
        src = inspect.getsource(AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer._propose)
        pad_idx = src.find("self._pad_draft_buffers(")
        build_idx = src.find("self.build_draft_attn_metadata(")
        if pad_idx != -1 and build_idx != -1:
            self.assertLess(pad_idx, build_idx)
